hide.description: Hide the placement from this time until a later frame or animation cue.

instance.description: Name of another uniquely named placement that is neither a tilemap nor attached itself.

point.description: A named point of its current frame; not drawn while that frame has no such point. Without one, follow where it stands, which stays on the ground while it is lifted (a contact shadow).

attach.description: Follow another placement; at becomes the offset from the point followed. Attached to a frame point, it stands on the other placement's ground line below the point and is lifted up to it, so a sorted held item sorts with its holder (list order decides which is in front).

sort.description: Draw among the other sorted placements by ground line (the y of the placement point), where the first of them is listed. A sorted tilemap joins cell by cell, each standing on the bottom row of its frame, so walls and trees taller than their tile cover what stands behind them.

time.description: Milliseconds or a named cue such as "jump+150".

ease.description: Shape of the change from this key to the next: linear (default), hold (jump at the end), in, out, inOut, overshoot or bounce.

lift.description: Draw this many pixels above where the placement stands, which still orders it: a jump or a flight keeps its ground line. A height, or keys of height over time, held before the first and after the last. Not on tilemaps.

shade.description: Draw no colours: wherever the frame is opaque, move the pixels beneath this many steps along the asset recipe's ramps (negative darkens). Not 0.

tile.description: [x, y] in unscaled canvas pixels; the top-left corner of that pixel.

outside.description: Cells beyond the map: empty (default), or matching every mask and rule pattern.

empty.description: A character, not a legend key, that stands for empty cells in rule patterns.

classes.description: Characters that stand for several map characters in rule patterns, e.g. {"#": "WV"}; include the empty character to match empty cells too.

seed.description: Reshuffles variant picks and rule chances, which are seeded by cell position; default 0.

layout.description: square (default): cells side by side, each drawing from its top-left. iso: a 2:1 diamond grid (even tile sizes such as [32, 16]), drawn back to front, cell [x, y] at [(x - y + rows - 1) * w/2, (x + y) * h/2]; each drawing stands on its diamond, bottoms aligned and centred across, so a block taller than the tile rises above its cell.

legend.description: Map characters to what they draw. Dot and space are empty cells.

oneOf.description: Frame name; with autotile, {mask} becomes the neighbour mask.

where.description: 3×3 characters centred on the cell. A dot matches anything, the tilemap's empty character matches empty cells (and cells beyond the map), a class matches its members, any other character matches itself.

chance.description: Seeded probability that a matching rule draws.

offset.description: [columns, rows] to draw into another cell; it draws over that cell's own tiles.

stop.description: When this rule draws, skip the rest of the cell's rules.

rules.description: Every rule that matches draws, in order, until one with stop draws.

oneOf.description: Context cell: never drawn, but it counts for other entries' match and for rules.

lit.description: false keeps this placement's authored colours under scene lighting: fires, lamps, glows and other light sources. Default true.

parallax.description: How much of scene.camera's movement this placement or tilemap follows, as a number or [x, y]: 1 the scene (default), 0.5 a far plane, 0 fixed on screen (a sky), above 1 a plane nearer than the scene. Each plane rounds its share to whole pixels. Not on attached placements, which move with their target.

haze.description: How far into scene.haze this placement or tilemap stands: each of its colours moves this much of the way to the haze colour, after lighting (0 none, 1 the haze colour).

shadow.description: Cast a shadow from each scene light that reaches this placement (or each tile of this tilemap): its frame, a cutout standing on its ground line and facing the light, stops that light on what is drawn before it (before its sorted group, when sorted). Needs lighting.lights; not on shade placements.

oneOf.description: [x, y] in unscaled canvas pixels; the top-left corner of that pixel.

at.description: [x, y] in unscaled canvas pixels; the top-left corner of that pixel.

ease.description: Shape of the move from this key to the next: linear (default), hold (jump at the end), in, out, inOut, overshoot or bounce.

camera.description: The scene point at the view's top-left corner: [x, y], or keys over time held before the first and after the last. Placements move by their parallax share of it; at [0, 0] everything is where it is written.

color.description: The colour far planes fade toward, usually the sky's.

colors.description: The only colours hazed placements may end on, with color: each faded colour becomes the nearest. List a fixed game palette, or a short ramp toward the haze for silhouettes. Without it, every colour fades exactly.

haze.description: Atmospheric haze for placements with haze: each colour fades as a whole, never per pixel, so each becomes one colour and keeps its place among the others.

scope.description: passes (default) lights only assets with normal/emissive passes; all also lights plain assets as flat surfaces.

mode.description: multiply (default) scales colours by the light; ramp moves each colour along its recipe's ramps instead, so the lit scene keeps its palette (light colour then only sets brightness).

steps.description: Ramp lighting: steps per unit of brightness away from 1; default 2.

at.description: Where the light is, the point on the ground under it for shadows; with follow, an offset from what it follows (default [0, 0]). Not on a sun.

height.description: Pixels above the scene; default 24. Not on a sun.

radius.description: How far it reaches; default 96. Not on a sun.

sun.description: Makes this light a sun: so far away it falls the same way everywhere, with no position, height or reach. [x, y] is how far a shadow falls across the ground per pixel of height: [1, 0.5] is a low sun up and to the left, whose shadows fall right and down; [0, 0] is overhead. Takes color, strength, flicker and strength keys.

strength.description: Brightness multiplier; default 1. Above 1, ramp lighting can lift colours past their authored shade (a flash); multiply lighting never brightens past the authored colour. 0 is off.

instance.description: Name of a uniquely named placement that is not a tilemap.

point.description: A named frame point of that placement (a torch flame, a blade tip); default: the placement point itself.

follow.description: Ride a placement as it moves, animates and attaches. The light is off while the placement is hidden or its current frame has no such point.

amount.description: How far it swings either way: 0.3 makes the strength vary from 70% to 130% of its own and the reach by up to 15% either way, so on average it is as bright as a steady light.

every.description: About how often the flicker changes, in milliseconds; default 80.

seed.description: Reorders the flicker; default 0. Each light flickers on its own even with the same seed.

flicker.description: Seeded, deterministic flicker that repeats once per scene duration, so a looping scene has no seam.

time.description: Milliseconds or a named cue such as "strike+70".

ease.description: Shape of the change from this key to the next: linear (default), hold (jump at the end), in, out, inOut, overshoot or bounce.

keys.description: Strength and radius over time, held before the first key and after the last: a flash on a hit, a lamp that lights later. Times increase strictly.

rows.description: Equal-width text rows. Every character is a palette key; dot and space skip a pixel.

mask.description: Neighbour mask. Blob: N=1, NE=2, E=4, SE=8, S=16, SW=32, W=64, NW=128, reduced so a diagonal counts only with both of its sides. Cardinal: N=1, E=2, S=4, W=8.

w.description: How far the top face's right edge runs across, in pixels (even); it runs half as far down.

d.description: How far the top face's left edge runs across, in pixels (even).

h.description: Height of the side faces in pixels; default 0, a flat diamond.

edge.description: Marks the top face's front edges and the corner between the side faces.

oneOf.description: An isometric box from the top-left of its bounds (w + d wide, (w + d) / 2 + h tall): a 2:1 top face over a left and a right face. Each pixel belongs to the face its centre lies in, so edges step two pixels across per row and boxes on a 2:1 grid meet exactly. A face without a colour is left out.

position.description: outside (default) surrounds the visible pixels; inside recolors their edge pixels; middle splits the width, the odd pixel outside.

directions.description: 3×3 grid centred on a visible pixel, with a dot in the centre: x marks the sides that get the line, e.g. ["...", "...", "..x"] for a drop shadow or [".x.", "...", "..."] for a top rim. Replaces diagonal.

oneOf.description: Outline every visible pixel in this buffer (frame or layer): outside rings, inside edge rings or both, in chosen directions.
